title: Research audit: exact encoded-bank dimension for open phase schedules
body:
PR2859 proves a workspace optimum when every phase column uses one assigned tensor-bank bit. This contribution removes that representation restriction: under an explicit separated-label, identical-paired-word contract, arbitrary invertible complex bank matrices have exactly the same weighted producer-prefix dimension requirement.

**Research audit / scoped theorem; no new κ.** Only `research/encoded-phase-bank/` is added.

The result gives:

- A necessary and sufficient commutation criterion for any double-occurrence schedule, including interleaved producers and consumers. All four generator-family commutation conditions across crossings are necessary.
- For producer-prefix consumer permutation π and block widths r_j, every valid bank dimension is divisible by `2^W`, where W is the maximum-weight increasing subsequence. An explicit coordinate-interval construction attains every such dimension. No Pauli coordinate basis, unitarity or irreducibility is assumed.
- A five-cycle schedule whose minimum dimension is eight, although its maximum crossing clique has size two. The dimension-four exclusion uses the full matrix commutant, not a finite Pauli search.
- An explicit dimension-one counterexample if separated-label dependence is dropped. That primitive already computes the desired joint-label phase and is not treated as a free supplier operation.

Start with `README.md` and `PROOF.md`. These are written all-size proofs with finite exact supporting checks, not a formal-kernel proof or a general lower bound for integer multiplication. The bank is arbitrary on every lane; prepared-state-only equality, extra corrections and changed second occurrences are excluded. All native execution, source access, movement, precision, caller and supplier/outer costs remain separate. No recursive child saving or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Validation on CPython 3.12.14 / Linux:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/encoded-phase-bank
```

All three registered commands pass, ending `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`:

- 139,434 exhaustive one-bit encoded schedule cases; one seeded two-bit encoding on each of 11,464 schedules; 31,287 weighted permutation cases checked against independent subset enumeration.
- A separate Fraction matrix implementation checks all 10,784 joint label/bank columns and 84,032 endpoint coefficients across non-Pauli, dense, weighted and C5 fixtures.
- Semantic controls isolate all four crossing conditions and reject wrong order, pairing, missing consumers and omitted terms. Optimized Git-free/read-only replay and reference/typed-receipt corruption controls pass.
- Selected source-binding check passes; the full selected cold replay is outside this additive theorem's scope. No hosted CI result is claimed.

Scientific base: `066766afb181a421eb851b8d73bb0ba71a78a170`, priority revision 5. Rebased onto canonical `30825d93b806a437d16267d897f814e4c9c9352c` with relevant guidance, selected record and runner unchanged. Exact inspected predecessor READMEs are retained and authenticated: Gareth Davidson / bitplane's PR2850 `a007c32f992195ad372806db38c9359dd49382ad`, and Dennis / antunishdPursuit's PR2859 scientific package `395b7fbde8f009263c8dceb46e0f2ee8a2a6e846`; its reference bytes are unchanged at live head `186a38eb`. No predecessor mathematical code is imported.

Concurrent credit: Dugongue's PR2871 `894a3edb` appeared during final overlap. Its P006/P056 give vector-control formulas and sufficient incidence encodings. This contribution adds arbitrary-GL necessity, sharp weighted dimension and the C5 commutant obstruction. Standard eigenspace/commutant/poset arguments retain their credit; no global priority claim.

[Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2842#discussioncomment-18965202). `TASK.json` records OS seed 70, three candidates, source pins, complete-paginated metadata searches and their limits, and the stop decision. A successor needs a paid changed caller contract; another basis search within this model cannot beat the proved prefix bound.

Prepared by Tekalign (@tekuuu), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, implementation, checking and writing. The separate implementations have the same AI-assisted author; no independent human review or subagents. Apache-2.0; predecessor attribution and source notices retained.
